priorityList: Pre-cast Aimed Shot and Steady Shot before combat begins.
Activate Trueshot when available, ideally coinciding with Volley.
Use offensive racial abilities and combat potions during Trueshot.
Use on-use trinkets during Trueshot or when Trueshot has more than 20 seconds remaining on its cooldown.
Cast Rapid Fire if you have the Unload talent and either (Precise Shots is active with fewer than 10 Bulletstorm stacks) or the target is below 20% health.
Cast Arcane Shot to consume Precise Shots stacks.
Cast Rapid Fire if your Bulletstorm buff will expire before you can finish an Aimed Shot cast.
Cast Aimed Shot when Volley is on cooldown (longer than 2 seconds) or during Trueshot, prioritizing targets with Sentinel's Mark.
Cast Steady Shot if you need to generate Focus or have no other abilities available.
